I generated the grouping distribution aggregates and plotted the corresponding Matplotlib chart.

**Console stdout:**
Aggregation completed. Matplotlib plot saved.
cells.code:
# Revenue by Region Bar Chart
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

grouped = df.groupby('region')['revenue'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 4.5))
colors = ['#6366f1', '#3b82f6', '#10b981', '#f59e0b', '#8b5cf6']
grouped.plot(kind='bar', color=colors[:len(grouped)])
plt.title("Total Revenue by Region", fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
plt.xlabel("Region", fontsize=10)
plt.ylabel("Revenue ($)", fontsize=10)
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.grid(axis='y', linestyle='--', alpha=0.3)
plt.tight_layout()
